items.title: Albert French Interview
items.q: And we were actually playing alto with Sam Dutry, tenor player.

ctx.x: I never got to know him. Yeah, George McCullin was playing trumpet with us. And we had alto player, Joe Harris. And we were actually playing alto with Sam Dutry, tenor player. You might hear talking Sam. That's the old man or the young man?
